Name: Rise of Rome
Description: Lead Rome from its legendary foundations through the struggles that forged the Republic.

rise_of_rome_01_romulus.Name: Romulus: Founding on the Tiber
rise_of_rome_01_romulus.Description: Defend the fledgling settlement on the Tiber and establish Rome's first foothold (legendary frame).

rise_of_rome_02_titus_tatius.Name: Titus Tatius: Sabine Conflict
rise_of_rome_02_titus_tatius.Description: Confront the Sabines and secure peace through strength in the early kingship era.

rise_of_rome_03_tullus_hostilius.Name: Tullus Hostilius: Alba Longa
rise_of_rome_03_tullus_hostilius.Description: Challenge Alba Longa and bring the rival Latin city under Roman leadership (Horatii–Curiatii era frame).

rise_of_rome_04_tarquinius_porsena.Name: Superbus and Porsena: Defense of the Tiber
rise_of_rome_04_tarquinius_porsena.Description: With monarchy fallen, hold the Tiber crossing against Lars Porsena's Etruscan host.
